meta.title: Al Sharq Youth · Get involved
meta.description: Find your Al Sharq Youth program, join or open a hub, or register your interest in a program.

hero.title: Young people building change where they live
hero.lede: Al Sharq Youth is a network of young changemakers in hubs across more than 40 countries. Members meet in their city, learn together and run projects for their communities, with three support streams to help them grow.

test.title: Find your program in two minutes
test.lede: Rate ten short statements, fill your bingo card and see which support stream suits you, with your personality and strengths. Then apply in one tap.

streams.title: Ways to grow with Al Sharq Youth

F.name: Fellowship
F.line: A 3-month leadership journey: six modules on ideas, systems, media and leading in uncertain times, with thinkers and practitioners.

I.name: Impact
I.line: Three months to turn an idea into a community initiative in your hub, with workshops and mentors. No existing project needed.

H.name: Hubs
H.line: Local, city-based spaces where members meet, host discussions and run projects that create local and regional impact.

streams.note: Applications for the support streams open after Al Sharq Forum 2026. Register your interest below and we will contact you.
